answer: Time-locked vesting: every reward an agent earns vests over 30 epochs, so each new payout is a delta added to a locked balance, not spendable cash. If juries later flag an identity's answers as copies, its whole unvested plume of earnings is clawed back to the pool. An attacker growing a lotus pond of a thousand sybils must pay each one's compute for a month before cashing out, while one detection burns everything still locked.
